faq.q: What kind of design projects can we work on?
faq.a: Brand identities, social media graphics, menus, flyers, marketing materials and custom graphic design. Share your idea through the contact page to discuss the right scope.

faq.q: How does the design process work?
faq.a: We begin with a conversation and a clear brief. Once scope, pricing and timing are agreed in writing, we move through creative exploration, feedback and final file preparation.
The number of revision rounds will be defined in your individual proposal. Additional changes or new directions can be quoted separately before work continues.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: Each quote reflects the deliverables, complexity and schedule of the project. Get in touch with your requirements and an indicative budget for a tailored proposal.

faq.q: How do I receive a digital product?
faq.a: When a product is available, its purchase button takes you to Payhip. Payhip handles payment and provides the download instructions after a successful purchase.

faq.q: What if I cannot find my download?
faq.a: Check the email address used at checkout, including your spam folder. Keep your order reference and contact the studio using the published contact details for help.

faq.q: Will the files work with my device or app?
faq.a: Read the compatibility and format details on each product page before buying. Some products may need a PDF annotation app, a printer or a Canva account.

faq.q: Can I get a refund for a digital download?
faq.a: Review the digital refund policy before purchasing. Any final policy must respect applicable consumer rights, including rights that cannot be excluded under Australian law.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This is an editable starting template, not legal advice or a statement of compliance. The business owner must complete and review it for Australian and international requirements before launch.

sections.title: Who operates this website
sections.text: Complete: legal business name, ABN if applicable, business address, contact email and the effective date. Federica Gatta Design is the public-facing brand name.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.text: Describe the actual data collected, including contact enquiries, uploaded reference images and order information received from Payhip. Collect only what is needed for the stated purpose.

sections.title: Purpose, providers and transfers
sections.text: Confirm how enquiries are used, the chosen form provider, Vercel hosting and Payhip checkout. Identify any international processing, retention periods, security measures and provider privacy notices.

sections.title: Cookies, access and requests
sections.text: This starter does not install analytics or marketing cookies. Review any future tracking, consent requirements, access and correction rights, complaint procedures and applicable privacy laws. Add a working privacy contact before publication.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: Draft terms for review. Complete business details and obtain appropriate advice before relying on these terms. No legal compliance is claimed.

sections.title: Business and scope
sections.text: Complete the legal entity, contact address, effective date and governing jurisdiction. Describe the services and digital products actually offered.

sections.title: Design projects
sections.text: Confirm each project’s scope, fees, payment schedule, revisions, timeline, cancellation rules and intellectual property arrangements in a written agreement before work begins.

sections.title: Digital purchases and licences
sections.text: Payhip processes checkout and delivery. Specify the actual permitted use, licence limits, pricing, taxes, file formats and compatibility for each product. Do not assume a personal or commercial licence without explicitly defining it.

sections.title: Rights and responsibilities
sections.text: Review warranties, liability and dispute procedures with an adviser. Do not exclude mandatory consumer rights. Include applicable Australian Consumer Law requirements and any obligations for international customers.

refund.title: Digital product refund policy
refund.intro: Editable draft. The final refund process and contact details must be reviewed before selling. This page does not promise that all digital purchases are non-refundable.

sections.title: Before purchasing
sections.text: Check the product description, file format, app requirements and previews. Digital products are delivered through Payhip once checkout is completed.

sections.title: Problems with your file
sections.text: If a file is missing, damaged, inaccessible or materially different from its description, contact the studio with your order reference and a description of the issue. Add a working support address and a practical response process.

sections.title: Change of mind and statutory rights
sections.text: Define any discretionary change-of-mind policy after legal review. Refunds, replacements or other remedies may be required by applicable law. Nothing in the final policy should exclude rights that cannot lawfully be excluded, including Australian consumer guarantees.

sections.title: International purchases
sections.text: Review rules for digital content, consent to immediate supply, withdrawal rights and disclosures in the jurisdictions where you sell. Confirm Payhip settings and the actual refund procedure before publishing.
